setTimeout waits DELAY_MS (1000 ms), a module constant that exported "stop" cannot override, so a test must wait it out or fake timers. Accept the delay as an option with DELAY_MS as its default, for example "{ delayMs = DELAY_MS } = {}". An exception fits only when the delay is deliberately fixed.

`expect(…).not.toBe(null)` passes for any value but null, the same weak check as `not.toBeNull`. Assert the value itself with `toBe` or `toEqual`, such as `expect(user).toEqual({ id: 1 })`. An exception fits only when the value cannot be pinned.

Prefer vi.waitFor / expect.poll over setInterval polling in tests.
Fixed sleeps are non-deterministic; wait on a condition with vi.waitFor or expect.poll. An exception fits only when a real wait is unavoidable.
